added_failure_note: Source manifest has neither baseline_suite nor after_suite and declares an unarmed suite fence. Zero is a neutral schema value, not a measured suite delta; no paired suite log exists from which to derive a numeric delta.
assertion_analysis: check_contract.py:75 fails when the sixth update is not freshly evaluated: reinstating the old pre-update acceptance leaves norms positive although the synthetic state reaches its independently defined root at six; negative-control.log records terminal_update=false and EXIT=1.

check_contract.py:119-124 compares a computed correction against an independently solved one-cell centroid target (height zero and field increment 0.1); removing the correction leaves height 0.1 and fails negative-control-centroid-row.log.
check_contract.py:164 observes both an absent and a known added residual row against literal expected output; hardcoding absent loses the true case, as negative-control-product-pin.log shows.

check_contract.py:179 fails if either prototype arm no longer calls accepted_read the required number of times; it checks syntax, not numerical predicate correctness, and negative-control-shared-acceptance.log records its refusal of the pre-shared-rule source.

check_contract.py:216-217 requires the actual compare.py to reject missing conditioning and accept a populated pair; removing the conditioning requirement makes the red pair pass and this control fail; the matching green pair proves only reproducibility, not physical correctness.
check_contract.py:235-237 checks the shared function string and removal of the old runner; it is structural evidence and by itself does not prove main calls the spectrum path.

check_contract.py:245-249 fails for durable receipts with fewer than two conditioning rows; it does not independently verify those rows numerically, which is the job of compare.py and the device receipt.

compare.py:34-44 refuses missing or unequal row counts, invalid conditioning reads or differing drive/singular values; changing one receipt would fail while matching common-mode numerical mistakes remain possible.

measure.py:63 refuses unexpected extra-row counts, measure.py:334 refuses an absent live scratch row or field column, and measure.py:426 refuses invalid or nonfinite selected singular values; each condition reads runtime results rather than its own constructor flag.

No added numerical correction assertion merely compares a value with the same target passed into the code: the one-cell height and field expectations are independent of the returned update; the shared acceptance substitution is the remaining coverage limitation.

The search also found existing production condition functions, supplying a positive search control.

figure_review.result: Both inspected; wall and line contours visible, no axes on poloidal panel, readable singular plot, no clipped or colliding labels.

findings.disposition: exempted: the focused controls establish the repaired sixth-update behavior and the current predicate is correct by inspection; direct invalid-read and over-tolerance predicate cases would improve future coverage without holding this measured diagnostic.
findings.summary: The sixth-update harness injects its own accepted_read instead of extracting the new predicate, while both_arms_share_acceptance only counts calls; a regression in measure.py:38-43 that accepts invalid or over-tolerance reads can leave all contract checks green.
